missionPremise: OPS-17 amendment A-081, 2026-08-19: eleven domains were registered and generating deterministic fixture data and THEY REACHED NO PIXEL. Four consecutive waves built everything underneath the lenses and never the lenses, and the operator's line in the dispatch is 'you have been running four hours, how have you not shipped the lens'. Underneath that sits RULING 1 (A-076, operator-approved in _inbox/2026-08-19_template_city_lens_build_sheet.md): 'not built' moved down one level from describing the SURFACE to describing SOURCES, because the product could not distinguish 'we did not build Parks' from 'your city has no Parks data' and those are different sentences to a customer. G-91 built the seam that makes the distinction expressible and W2DS/W2DEPT filled it; this lane makes it VISIBLE on the one lens with a live production comparison. The operator's own words, carried in the dispatch: Development services must match the data the PRODUCTION Bastrop dashboard shows today, because it monitors the MyGov system the city already runs.
completionPredicate: A stranger can evaluate this without me by running six things against PR 34 and the clone at P:/tmp/r1-dash. (1) `npm test` returns 383 pass 0 fail, against 320 on the lane's original base 78a2b9a. (2) `npx playwright-core install chromium && npm run test:a11y` exits 0 and prints 'a11y gate PASSED: 0 unwaived conformance node(s) and 0 waived over 46 surfaces, 0 title findings, 0 focus findings over 1066 keyboard stops'. (3) Serving the branch and walking `/?lens=development-services&tab=<t>&cityKey=template-city` in a browser shows five regions rendering 14, 21, 15, 19 and 17 rows, each with its counting rule beside its numbers. (4) The same six tabs on `?cityKey=empty-city` render zero rows, every region quiet, every one carrying a basis. (5) Fulfilling `/api/domains/inspections` with a payload the REAL seam composes against a pack that has granted nothing, and again against a pack that has granted mygov with a generator that returns nothing, renders two visibly different sentences. (6) `git diff origin/main -- web/sc-kit.css` is empty and `stylesheetClasses().size` is 143. All six are recorded below with raw results.
scopeBasis: IN, and why these boundaries. The `<section id="lens-development-services">` block, the four Development services regions that reached no pixel, and the one that already did. The DS-only enumerations that the tab roster change forces: DS_TABS in src/staff-review.mjs, TAB_LABELS in both its module home and the head script's forced second copy, and the html[data-tab] show list in web/shell.css. The four tests that pinned the removed Review tab by name. OUT and deliberately so: R2's Police and Fire and EMS sections and R3's Fleet and Public works sections, which are other lanes' clones and other lanes' section blocks, never opened; web/sc-kit.css, byte-identical across three product repos, where a token edit forks the system; connecting a feed or granting an adapter, which the standing decisions forbid; G-52; G-24, which stays at zero and is asserted; adding a city pack, which would make ungranted reachable on this lens but is an operator ruling on the three identities and is raised as a recommendation instead; merging and deploying, which are planner-owned. NOT out of scope but STATED so it is not mistaken for an exclusion: the `--sc-ok` contrast pair is a real AA failure this lane measured, could not fix inside this repo, and routed rather than absorbed.
